actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten and Revised World Encyclopedia sections on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.headword: 御手洗, みたらし; separate おてあらい section
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual みたらし purification-place definition, separate restroom definition, and encyclopedia explanation credited to 西垣晴次.
actualEntryInspections.observation: みたらし identifies the place for cleaning hands and rinsing the mouth before worship. The place may historically be a natural river rather than only a manufactured basin. おてあらい is separately a polite restroom expression.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The Digital Daijisen heading rendered without its definition; do not attribute Seisenban or encyclopedia text to Daijisen. Historical breadth does not establish current frequency or every shrine's practice.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual noun definition describing respectful reference to someone's going out.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the respectful outing expression. JMdict separately records the about-to-leave greeting and the outing/trip noun.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The Seisenban respectful definition does not make every modern outing noun use honorific toward another person, or establish an exhaustive register rule.

actualEntryInspections.headword: 御手伝いさん, おてつだいさん
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual household-worker definition and explanation as a replacement term for 女中.
actualEntryInspections.observation: A woman hired to assist with domestic work; supports the established maid/domestic-worker meaning rather than every volunteer helper.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Not proof of a universally preferred modern job title or an invitation to recommend older 女中 as a neutral default. JMdict marks the fully written 御 variant search-only.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten sections on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual godan definition with やり方を教わる; Seisenban transitive instruction and information uses.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Receiving instruction or learning information from someone. The verb is godan and transitive, not passive morphology or ichidan because of English be taught.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Does not establish that 教わる, 習う and 学ぶ replace one another in every construction or that a professional teacher is required.
